text:
jessica: getting a spike of 503s from embeds service (customer ACME). incident-bot shows a page logged as sent at 1768887765 but @ops-oncall says they didn't get any SMS/call. Anyone else missing pages?

incident-bot: [incident-bot] Page attempt 1 -> route=primary-sms status=sent message_id=pg_98345. Ack timeout=90s. Logged webhook -> notify-relay.

mike: I got nothing. Checked Twilio logs for pg_98345 and there's no outgoing request.

sophie: notify-relay shows a suppressor hit for that customer: `suppressor: duplicate_event detected for customer_id=acme-42`. Looks like the relay accepted the webhook (202) but then suppressed downstream paging. So bot thinks "sent" because relay accepted it.

incident-bot: [incident-bot] Webhook deliver status: 202 accepted -> to notify-relay. suppressor_response=blocked. STAMP log snippet: ```suppressor.check(payload_hash=0x7adf2c, customer_id=acme-42) -> result=blocked (window=60s)```

jessica: that matches. So incident-bot -> notify-relay -> suppressor blocked actual pager. We need pages restored and customer impact assessed ASAP.

ops-oncall: manually paging chain now (calling). Also sending backup manual SMS to escalation list. `/page @ops-oncall via sms +1-555-0100` (done).

infra-sre: digging into suppressor config — last week someone added a per-customer dedupe with `threshold:1 window:60s` for ACME. That's too strict given their bursty traffic. I can reduce window to 10s and roll within 30s.

mike: FYI incident-bot also attempted automated handoff to secondary after ack timeout, but the relay suppressed that one too. We should disable duplicate suppression for paging webhooks while we triage.

sophie: patching suppressor config now: `PATCH /suppressor/configs/acme-42 { "window": 10 }` -> will hold a rollback plan.

incident-bot: [incident-bot] Page attempt 2 -> route=secondary-email status=sent message_id=pg_98346.

customer-success: ACME pinged support at 12:42 UTC about timeouts, ~12% of requests failing. CS opened ticket and flagged P2, possible SLA impact.

jessica: mitigation plan (short):
1) disable duplicate suppression for paging webhooks for acme-42 (temporary)
2) keep manual pages active until confirm delivery chain healthy
3) infra-sre to adjust rule permanently and add separate buckets for paging vs alerts
4) owner for postmortem: @mike

mike: I'll own the postmortem. Disabling suppressor for paging webhook now.

ops-oncall: received manual call & SMS. Confirmed. Starting mitigation: scaling embeddings service +2 nodes and deploying fallback branch.

infra-sre: suppressor patched to 10s window. Creating follow-up ticket to add non-deduped path for incidentbot->notify-relay for paging payloads (ticket INF-4621).

incident-bot: [incident-bot] audit -> pages_attempted:2, delivered_confirmed:1, suppressed:1, acked:false.

jessica: preliminary customer impact: roughly 6 minutes of degraded traffic during the missed-page window. @customer-success please send interim update to ACME and capture affected request counts/time windows.

customer-success: Sending update now: "We're investigating elevated error rates impacting some customers. Our on-call team is engaged; we'll provide updates within 30 minutes." Adding timeline and ticket link.

sophie: root cause hypothesis: notify-relay suppressor dedupe logic matched events because incident-bot payload lacked a stable `unique_event_id`. Relay hashed payload and considered both pages duplicates. Fix: ensure incident-bot attaches `unique_event_id` and relay uses that as dedupe key.

mike: postmortem notes to capture: - missing unique_event_id in incident-bot -> notify-relay payload - suppressor rule too aggressive for bursty customers - no delivery-confirmation alert when relay suppresses a paging webhook (monitoring gap).

jessica: thanks all. Keep thread for postmortem artifacts. I'll escalate to eng lead to update paging policy and require delivery-confirmation metrics.

ops-oncall: once infra confirms stable delivery, I'll close the incident and hand over to mike for writeup. :white_check_mark:

sophie: quick debug log (payload example):
```json
{"service":"embeds","severity":"P2","customer_id":"acme-42","alert_type":"error_rate","timestamp":1768887764}
```
Note: no `unique_event_id`.

mike: adding action items to PM board and will post follow-up in this thread with postmortem link.

jessica: 👍 good work. We'll follow up with RCA + timeline in 48h.
